title: Fake authorities in practice
intro: Fake prosecutor, court and tax traps. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Notice of a criminal case
decisions.prompt: Look at the sender's domain. What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: Notice of a criminal case
body: Your name appears in a criminal case. Read the attached materials within 24 hours.

decisions.explain: Fake domain, threat and archive: reporting protects your colleagues too.

decisions.title: Call from Central Investigation Bureau

artifact.name: Central Investigation Bureau
body: This is investigator Elçin Həsənov, Central Investigation Bureau. You ignored this morning's notice, and your name appears in a criminal case.

options.label: What should I do? Tell me
I will call the bureau's official number myself

decisions.explain: A real investigator will not object to you checking.

decisions.title: Court summons
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: Court summons
body: You must appear in court tomorrow at 10:00.

decisions.explain: Report a summons from a foreign domain and call the court yourself if needed.

decisions.title: Official letter for you
decisions.prompt: Is this message safe or a scam?

artifact.subject: Official letter for you
body: An official letter from the court has arrived in your name. You can collect it from the registry office against signature.

decisions.explain: The letter came through the institution's own channel and asks for no money or link.

decisions.title: Message from +994 70 000 52 19
decisions.prompt: Is this message safe or a scam?

body: Central Investigation Bureau: transfer your fine to this card within 2 hours: 4169 **** 7731

decisions.explain: Law enforcement does not collect fines to a personal card. Report this message.
